checked_against: pdftoppm -r 110 -gray renders of pages 2-12 of data/legal-sources/library/amendments/28-2022-powers-of-attorney-amendment-act.pdf (RGD copy of the Government Printer Act, 13-page scan, no text layer)
quality_notes: The RGD PDF is a 13-page 1-bit scan with no text layer (pdftotext returns 13 characters). It was read with ocr_scanned_act.py (doctr, offline) into the sidecar named in edition.local_path; parse_amendment_pdf.py over that sidecar produced 8 sections with the columns interleaved and the Schedules read as body text, so the whole tree was rebuilt by hand from the page renders. raw_text on each section is the OCR reading of the corresponding sidecar lines; text is the corrected reading; every correction is listed in corrections.

The printed short title of the Act reads 'Powers of Attorney (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 2022'. The Act refers to the Ordinance as Chapter 122; the RGD's own consolidated PDF of the Ordinance prints 'Cap. 140' (the 1980 revised-edition chapter number).
Section 2(2) repeals 'the definition of the expression “Registrar General”'; the LankaLaw baseline prints the term hyphenated, 'Registrar-General'. Treated as the same definition.

Section 8 (Transitional Provisions) and section 9 (Sinhala text) do not amend the principal enactment's text and are not applied to the principal tree; Act No. 3 of 2024 s.6 later varies the s.8(1)(a) period.

Punctuation kept as printed: 'in his attestation: and' (3B(1)(b)); 'the Registrar General, shall make' (4(2)(b)); 'shall be valid, only for' (3C); 'sections 3A, 3B, 3C and 3D, of that enactment' (s.4).
